description: Construction of a mansard roof extension and refurbishment of existing hotel (Use Class C1) comprising elevational alterations including the removal and installation of new windows, increase roof height of existing rear outrigger, new shopfront and associated works.
decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, details and full specifications of 1 bird box and 1 bat box shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and shall be maintained for the lifespan of the development. The details should include</p><ul><li style="margin-left: 15px;">A minimum of 1 bird box incorporated into the design of the development, with a variety of box types (including different-sized entrance holes) to provide habitat for diverse bird species. The boxes should be installed at or close to the eaves level of the development hereby approved. The boxes should be between 3 and 5 metres from the ground, and there should be a clear flight path without any obstructions below and directly in front of the box. The boxes should be facing north, east, or north east (direct sunlight should be avoided), and should not be placed immediately above doors or windows.&nbsp;Boxes located in the same area should not be placed too close together; and&nbsp;</li><li style="margin-left: 15px;">A minimum of 1 bat box is incorporated into the design of the development. Boxes should be placed at or close to the eaves level of the development and at least 4m above the ground. The boxes should be placed away from artificial light sources and ideally located near dark tree lines or hedgerows where possible.&nbsp;The boxes should be located facing south, southeast, or southwest, and exposed to the sun for part of the day.</li></ul><p>REASON:<br>To support bird and bat populations, including swifts, in Hackney and preserve endangered urban&nbsp;<span class="il">biodiversity</span>&nbsp;by providing nesting opportunities.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Prior to the occupation of the development, details of the refuse storage for the proposed units shall be submitted to the local planning authority for approval in writing. The storage shall be installed in full prior to occupation of the hereby approved unit and retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development.<br><br>REASON: To ensure the development provides adequate waste storage.</p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p>All new external facing and roofing materials in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works carried out in this connection) shall match those of the existing building.</p><p>

REASON: In the interests of preserving the appearance of the host building and wider terrace.</p>

<p><span data-sheets-root="1" style="">Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved, precise details of cycle parking shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall, thereafter be carried out in strict accordance with the approved details. The area for cycle parking shall be kept clear of obstruction other than for its intended purpose.<br><br>REASON: To promote sustainable transport.</span></p>
